name: orgbots
summary: Directory of 421 installable Grok Bot packs: teams of named bots shared by their authors, with official install links.
description: A community directory of Grok Bot packs, where each pack is a small roster of named bots (desk, engineer, recruiter …) that already knows a job's stack and tone, so repeat work becomes named seats instead of a blank prompt. Browse featured and trending packs and top authors, open an author's pack page, or submit your own; install is official Grok only, previewing a template on x.ai and adding it in the Grok app.
